title: Pay gaming machine tax
what: Pay gaming tax each financial year on the net gambling revenue from the licensed premises.

sources.title: Gaming Machines Act 1992 (SA)
sources.publisher: SA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: The holder of a gaming machine licence must pay to the Treasurer, for each financial year, the prescribed gaming tax on the net gambling revenue derived in respect of the licensed premises in the financial year
